name: Remove Taffy Vendor Surface

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: gpux Taffy dependency sourcing and apps/test_suite wide DataTable headed WebGPU
hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

Returning Taffy 0.12.2 to its normal crates.io release and removing the 24,000-line local vendor surface will preserve gpux layout/render behavior while materially reducing RayX repository size and maintenance cost. The gpux skill can retain compact provenance requirements while preferring crates.io, allowing exact-revision forks for essential tiny patches, and reserving full vendoring and dedicated workflow references for genuinely justified complexity.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

1. Remove the root and nested `[patch.crates-io]` entries for Taffy, delete `crates/gpux/vendor/taffy`, and regenerate both lockfiles so `taffy = 0.12.2` resolves from crates.io.
2. Delete the one-off Taffy update reference and replace its routing/rules with a concise general dependency-source policy in the gpux skill.
3. Update the current gpux memory and architectural decision so they no longer claim the vendored patch is active, while retaining its measured result as historical evidence.
4. Run dependency-tree proof, the focused Taffy telemetry test, all gpux library tests, diagnostics-disabled/enabled gpux/WGPU/browser-WASM checks, warning-denied gpux Clippy, package-scoped formatting, AgentX memory audit, and loop validation.
5. Run three fresh headed Test Suite WebGPU processes at DPR 1 and DPR 2. Require exact Taffy/renderer/tree/final-scroll counters and zero terminal error.
6. Accept the source-bloat reduction when correctness is exact because the user explicitly prioritizes removing the vendor surface; report any measured runtime regression transparently and retain the inline-child optimization only as an upstream/fork candidate.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

RayX deletes roughly 24,000 tracked Taffy source lines and resolves Taffy 0.12.2 from crates.io with its checksum in both lockfiles. Layout and renderer counters remain exact. Runtime may return toward the pre-inline-storage distribution; that cost is recorded as the explicit trade for repository and maintenance simplicity until an upstream or exact-revision fork carries the optimization.

playwright: Three independent headed Chromium/WebGPU processes; each passed the focused wide DataTable benchmark at DPR 1 and DPR 2 (6/6 project runs).
Every build verified shared WASM memory, wasm_thread_entry_point, and 103206 atomic prefix bytes.
rayx: apps/test_suite was the exclusive runtime fixture and validation target.
All 400 gpux library tests passed; native and single-thread WASM checks passed with diagnostics disabled and enabled; warning-denied gpux/WGPU Clippy and package-scoped formatting passed.
counters: All six browser results preserved Taffy counters 1123/229/341/782/1041/25/673/726/755/780/405/377/0/82/0/0.

All six browser results preserved 9 batches, 12 queue writes, 10 bind groups, 2 render passes, 1 submission, 4440 bounds visits, 576 retained nodes, 8668 global-id path elements, final offset -351402.6875, and zero terminal errors.
